criteria.requirement: Fix actual IceCreamDebugger._formatArgs so ast.Starred expansion never truncates calculated values via zip. Preserve reliably identifiable ordinary prefix/suffix expressions; label indeterminate expanded middle values explicitly by index without guessing source lengths or reevaluating/reiterating expressions/generators. Support multiple/empty expansions, ordinary args between stars, no-source fallback and single/multiple passthrough object identity. Keep ordinary nonstar source/literal formatting unchanged and ensure every calculated argument appears once in output.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
